name: Dabronc (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dabronc: a crowned blue shield with a yellow sun and a white charge, with a helm, a cross crest and blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed DABRONC.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Dabronc arms with crown, helm, crest, mantling and scroll
